entries.name: Hierarchy
entries.content:
Regardless of the personality of a person or their primary sex (female or male) alphas are the highest rank in the dominance hierarchy and may exhibit 'dominant' behavior or other temperamental quirks. Betas are subordinate to Alphas in the dominance hierarchy. Omegas are the lowest in the dominance hierarchy.Alphas are thought of as the leaders, the heads of households, the bread winners, etc.
 Betas are known as the peacemakers and rule followers. They are expected to keep to the background.  Omegas are often thought of as being most fragile and often borderline infantilized by bigots. They are also thought of as fierce home and nest protectors.

entries.name: Pregnancy

Knots lock the alpha penis inside whatever orifice they are fucking and will lock them with their partner for a certain duration that can vary from a few minutes to half an hour. Betas have 'normal' human anatomy, with none of the special attributes of Alphas or Omegas. Omegas can get pregnant and go into heat (needing sex, this is at their most fertile). Male Omegas are often intersexed and if the are not they are self-lubricating. Nearly all omegas have the ability to become pregnant. Omegas like to nest (make a soft area with their favorite things) when pregnant. It's very rude to enter a nest without permission from an omega. It's considered traditional to help an omega mate make a nest and then wait for permission to enter.

Most Alphas may be jealous and possessive of their mate, even if they are just a "regular" mate. The Omega may become highly clingy and needy when new to a relationship and right after bonding.

Traditional alphas, betas, and omegas also have more traditional attire that they wear for celebrations. Progressives tend to look down on this attire due to the connotations.
